asker_query: Didi, my husband has had more cough for 4 days, sputum has increased slightly but is white, there is no fever, slight breathlessness. What should we do, should I give an antibiotic? Or take him to the doctor?
answer:
For mild AECOPD with white sputum and no fever, antibiotics are not indicated. Focus on optimizing bronchodilators (tiotropium + salbutamol), monitor for worsening signs (purulent sputum, fever, SpO2 <90%), and consider short-term oral corticosteroids if symptoms persist. Avoid routine antibiotics; reassess if clinical features change. Non-pharmacological measures (e.g., positioning, oxygen if SpO2 <93%) and patient education on symptom management are critical. {retrieved from
